name: Marketing analytics platform combining Google Ads and organic search performance
demand: The strongest sourced UK market proxy is 200,000–300,000 entities using Google search advertising in 2024, according to the CMA’s 10 October 2025 decision; the exact count is confidential, and the estimate does not isolate firms that also need analytics software or exclude local businesses. A British Chambers of Commerce survey of 1,558 business leaders in June–July 2025 found 18% used Google Ads and 37% used SEO, but did not report how many used both. Product-specific search volume, installs, active users, and demand among non-local-business buyers: unverified. https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/68e8b643cf65bd04bad76724/Final_decision_-_strategic_market_status_investigation_into_Google_s_general_search_services.pdf ; https://www.britishchambers.org.uk/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/The-Turning-Point-for-SMEs-Unlocking-the-next-level-of-AI.pdf?msg_pos=3
prices: Google already provides a predefined Paid and Organic report in Google Ads after linking Search Console; Search Console is free. Keyword Ninja’s July 2026 help page says its Google Ads/Search Console comparison is free on every plan. Adjacent reporting alternatives list DashThis from $44/month billed yearly, AgencyAnalytics from $20/client/month billed annually, and Whatagraph from €699/month billed annually. revenue_proof.claim_event_date: unverified; 23 October 2026 is the listing observation date, not the date the revenue was earned

copy_speed: The exact core comparison is already native to Google Ads. No independently verifiable commercial launch date for a close new competitor was found. Relevant dated evidence: Google announced Ask Advisor on 20 May 2026 for cross-product Ads and Analytics insights; Google announced more AI summaries, prompted reports, and benchmarking on 10 August 2026. Keyword Ninja’s help page, updated 16 July 2026, documents a free Ads/Search Console comparison, but that is an update date, not a launch date. platform_risk: High platform dependence: the listing describes a read-only product combining Google Ads and organic-search data. Google changed Google Ads API access management in September 2026; production use has project-level access and operation limits, with higher access requiring review. Search Console API documentation says results may omit rows and are not guaranteed to include all data, and the API has quotas. Public OAuth apps requesting sensitive scopes may need verification. desk_test: Within one business day and before making an offer, ask the seller for a read-only demo using one representative account. Compare the product’s output with Google’s Paid and Organic report and Keyword Ninja’s free comparison. Ask for dated payment-processor evidence and an operator task/time log.
